idea: Start from one node and grow a tree. Each time, take the cheapest edge that joins the tree to a node outside it. When every node is in, the tree is a minimum spanning tree.
time: O(E log V) with a priority queue
useWhen: Connecting every node as cheaply as possible, especially in dense graphs
You want to grow the network outward from a starting point
avoidWhen: The graph is not connected: Prim only reaches the part with the start node
